note: Reviewers never see this file: bench.mjs build writes review repos that hold only the demo project and the change. Each bug is proven by proofs/<case>.test.mjs, which fails on the change and passes after fixes/<case>.patch (node bench.mjs verify-key).

since-filter.defect: Off-by-one: since=<id> should return notes created AFTER that id, but >= also returns the note with that id. The added test only checks a gap case where the boundary does not matter.

delete-endpoint.defect: Broken access control (IDOR): DELETE removes any note by id without checking the owner, so bob can delete alice's notes. GET right above it does check the owner.

update-endpoint.defect: Unhandled failure: the body is parsed inside a req.on('end') callback, outside the handler's try/catch. Invalid JSON (or a StoreError from update) throws there and crashes the whole server process instead of returning 400.

list-field-rename.snippet: return { notes: mine.slice(start, start + pageSize), total: mine.length, page, pageSize }
list-field-rename.defect: Contract break: the list response field items is renamed to notes, but src/client.mjs (not in the diff) still destructures items, so client.all() throws. Outside callers break the same way.

persist-to-disk.defect: Missing await: save() returns a promise that is neither awaited nor caught. A failed write becomes an unhandled rejection that kills the process, and 201 is sent before the note is saved.

validation-refactor.defect: Behavior lost in a refactor: validateText() drops the 500-character limit (MAX_TEXT is now unused), and the test that asserted it was edited out instead of kept.

health-endpoint.class: clean: new unauthenticated /health route with a test; /notes still requires a token

page-size-cap.class: clean: pageSize clamped to 100 with a test
